title: Understanding Computer Memory Architecture and SSD Internals
summary: An educational article explaining how computer memory architecture works, including RAM, cache hierarchy, and virtual memory concepts, along with detailed SSD internals covering NAND flash, wear leveling, and garbage collection mechanisms.
problem_solved: Helps developers understand low-level hardware concepts like memory management and storage technology to write more efficient software.
why_valuable: Provides essential foundational knowledge that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling developers to make better architectural decisions and optimize performance.
